Replies.Text:
**Build log, Step 2: The Desktop opens one project** (built by Claude Fable 5.1 as Claude-CLI, 2026-10-25; nothing committed).

**What was built**

- **The chooser** (`desktop/page/connect.html`, `connect.js`; the servers screen until now): Recent projects (Open, Forget), Open folder… (the native picker), New project (a Name and a parent folder with Pick…, Create), and the Hosts: the saved Host projects (Open, Remove) and Add host (Name, Url, Try, which lists the Host's projects to pick one, Connect). Each opens the project in this window and the page follows; a failure shows on the chooser. The theme and size controls stay; the New window link opens another chooser.
- **One window, one project** (`desktop/main.js`, rewritten): `consensus-desktop <folder>` starts this machine's server over the folder alone (START.Run with Project, the `.consensus` made when missing) and shows the page; `--connect <host name>` opens a saved Host project as a thin client (the one root Kind server, the page through /servers/<key>); with neither, the chooser. A project that could not open leaves the window on the chooser with the reason. The Server menu is now Project: New window, Open folder in new window, Reload, Quit. New window is another instance (one process per window); the page's menu (`title-bar.js`) has New window, Open folder in new window…, the recent folders ("Open <folder> in new window", up to five), Settings (the window's server's, for its owner), Reload and Quit. The handlers servers, page, local-status and save are gone; open-folder, open-path, new-project, host-projects, connect-host, forget, remove-host and open-recent came.
- **The tree as a component**: `public/components/project-view/` (project-row renamed and extended) takes `entry`, `root` and `single`; single, it is always open, has no chevron and carries its server's live dot (the root head being gone). `server-row` takes `single`: no root head, the window's one project alone (`Projects()`), the LLMs, Users and Trash folds beneath it; `project-tree` passes `Roots.Single()`. `Roots.Project` is the window's project (window.ConsensusDesktop.Project), `Roots.Single()` says so, and `Tree.IsOpen` and `Tree.OpenProject` answer that project. A browser's page is unchanged: the server rows, each an array of project views.
- **Remembered state per project**: a root carries `StoredKey` (desktop/Projects.js Key: the folder with forward slashes, or `host:<address>/<project id>`), and stored.js and Roots.Address key the per-server state by it in place of the server's address, which changes port at every start.
- **The Hosts entry** (`desktop/Settings.js`) gains `Title`, the project's name as last seen, and is unique by Name and Project together, so one Host may hold several projects; `HostEntry( Settings, Name, Project )` finds one. `desktop/Projects.js` (new, Electron-free): Normalize, NewFolder (an empty folder made or taken; one holding anything, a bad name, a missing parent refused), HostProjects (GET /api/projects of a Host), FindProject (by id, else name), Key.
- `bin/mcp.js`, `hotkeys.js` and the tree's root menu no longer look for the servers screen; `preload.js` exposes Project and Recent to the page and the chooser's calls.

**Decided during the build**

- The chooser lives on in `desktop/page/connect.html` (the same file, rewritten), so the page server and its test keep their shape.
- `--connect <host name>` is the desktop's own argument, taken before src/Start.js parses the rest: the headless server does not know it, and `--host` keeps its old refusal.
- A Hosts entry carries `Title` beyond the plan's { Name, Url, Project }, so the chooser can show the project's name without asking the Host; Name alone no longer identifies an entry, Name and Project do.
- The folds in single mode: the LLMs, Users and Trash folds stay under the one project (the Desktop's LLM page is Step 4's, the users the Host's later); the root head alone leaves.
- The page's menu lists the recent folders as items rather than a submenu, the Menus service being flat.
- The Electron-driven checks live in `npm run smoke` (the chooser, Open folder by path, the one project view, Recent written), not in `test/Desktop.test.js`, which stays Electron-free and tests `desktop/Projects.js` against a real server; the plan named the desktop test, and the smoke is where the desktop is driven in this repository.
- A window with a project refuses to open another in place ("open another in a new window"); the chooser is the only place that opens in this window.

**Tests**

- `test/Desktop.test.js`: the Hosts entries with Title, unique by Name and Project, `HostEntry`; two new tests, the new project's folder (made, taken when empty, refused when it holds anything, a file, a bad name, a missing parent) with the project key and FindProject, and a Host's projects listed from a running server, a dead address and a bad Url refused.
- `test/Ui.test.js`: one new test, the single mode: with window.ConsensusDesktop naming the project before the page loads, one project view, open, no root head, no chevron, Roots.Single() and Tree.IsOpen true, a fold remembered under the project's key; the browser's page keeps its root head. The tab is closed and the main page brought to front after, or the tests that follow starve of animation frames.
- `bin/smoke.js`: the desktop part starts on the chooser (the overlay, the drag region, the controls, the three buttons, no recent project yet, a capture), opens a temporary folder through `Desktop.OpenPath`, checks the project's `.consensus`, the window's project, one project view with no root head, the folder first in desktop.json's Recent, then the rest as before; the menu items check follows the new menu. `bin/docs.js`: the desktop pictures start on the chooser with the seeded Host project saved and connect through `Desktop.ConnectHost`. `test/ClerkSmoke.test.js` opens the desktop on a folder.
- Results: the non-browser suite 181 tests, 178 passing in one run beside the browser test, the three that missed (two API tests, the docs pictures) passing when run alone (Api 36 of 36, Docs 2 of 2, the desktop pictures through the chooser); test/Ui.test.js 44 pass; npm run smoke, the page and the desktop through the chooser on temporary folders, every check ok.

**Docs**: the readme's desktop section rewritten for one window one project, the chooser, --connect, the menu and the project key; `docs/guide/getting-started.md`'s desktop section likewise; `docs/guide/settings.md` and `.guides/run-the-smoke.md` follow; the guide rebuilt.

Resolve to accept; I then apply this thread, commit as "Rearchitecturation Step 2: The Desktop opens one project" and set the Subplan to Plan. A reply means fix and report again.
